grid.export_chain_hint: What SunCore may do about feed-in beyond the static limit above. Writing to the inverter needs a verified inverter adapter.

grid.export_limit_pct_hint: Needs the installed power (kWp) of every solar array in the Solar step.

grid.import_limit_hint: Optional. The most you may draw from the grid, for example from your main fuse.

grid.para14a_enable: My installation is controllable under section 14a

grid.para14a_signal_hint: A binary sensor or switch that shows when the grid operator reduces your power.

grid.peak_floor_hint: Draw below this value is never limited; above it SunCore tries not to set a new monthly peak.

grid.power_hint: One sensor that is positive when you draw from the grid and negative when you feed in.
grid.zero_export_hint: Use surplus on site and never feed in on purpose.

planner.device.surplus: {device} runs on solar surplus ({power_w, number, ::0} W).
planner.device.throttled: {device} waits: the battery needs the surplus to reach {soc_pct, number, ::.0} % by {time}.
planner.ev.floor: {device} charges {power_w, number, ::0} W {mode, select, now {at full power (mode Now)} other {at least at the minimum current (mode Min+PV)}}.
planner.ev.grid_for_target: {device} charges {power_w, number, ::0} W from the grid at {price, number, ::.000}/kWh to reach its target by {time}.
planner.ev.need_unknown: {device}: the energy the vehicle needs is unknown (no state of charge or capacity); only the coming quarter hour is planned for it.
planner.ev.not_connected: {device}: no vehicle connected and no arrival known; the charger is left out of the plan.
planner.ev.surplus: {device} charges on solar surplus ({power_w, number, ::0} W).
planner.ev.target_shortfall: {device} cannot reach its target by {time}: {need_kwh, number, ::.0} kWh needed, the plan expects {planned_kwh, number, ::.0} kWh.
planner.export.limit: The export limit ({limit_w, number, ::0} W) is reached: the rest of the solar power would be curtailed.
planner.export.negative_price_avoided: Export pays nothing now ({price, number, ::.000}/kWh): the surplus goes into the battery and consumers instead.
planner.fallback.error: The optimiser failed ({error}); the rule-based plan is used.
planner.fallback.heuristic_better: The rule-based plan is cheaper than the optimiser's interim result ({status}) and is used.
planner.fallback.infeasible: The optimiser could not solve the model; the rule-based plan is used.
planner.fallback.invalid_solution: The optimiser's plan failed the feasibility check ({violations} violations); the rule-based plan is used.
planner.fallback.no_prices: No electricity prices: planning for self-sufficiency only, without price optimisation.
planner.fallback.solver_unavailable: The optimiser (HiGHS) is not available; the rule-based plan is used.
planner.fallback.spot_without_formula: {source} delivers bare spot prices and no price formula is configured: planning without price optimisation until the formula is set.
planner.fallback.timeout: The optimiser found no plan within {budget_s, number, ::.0} s; the rule-based plan is used.
planner.grid.import: The house draws {power_w, number, ::0} W from the grid at {price, number, ::.000}/kWh.
planner.grid.import_limit_exceeded: The demanded loads exceed the import limit of {limit_w, number, ::0} W ({import_w, number, ::0} W planned); the safety layer will hold the limit.
planner.grid.para14a: §14a EnWG: the grid operator dims controllable devices to {budget_w, number, ::0} W together; no grid charging meanwhile.
planner.grid.para14a_unknown: §14a EnWG: the control signal is unknown; the flagged devices are not increased.
planner.grid.peak: Peak shaving: the plan expects a monthly peak of {peak_w, number, ::0} W (capacity price {price, number, ::.00} per kW and month).
planner.heuristic.rules: Rule-based plan: battery first up to the morning buffer, then consumers on surplus while the evening target stays reachable; grid charging only to reach a target.
planner.input.device_power_unknown: The power of {device} is unknown: it is left out of the plan.
planner.input.no_battery_soc: The battery's state of charge is unknown: the battery is left out of the plan.
planner.input.no_load_forecast: No load forecast yet: the plan assumes a flat base load of {load_w, number, ::0} W and plans no consumers.
planner.input.no_pv_forecast: No solar forecast: the plan assumes no solar power.
planner.input.prices_partial: Prices are known until {known_until}; {filled_slots} later quarter hours are planned with the median price.
planner.interval.balanced: Nothing to plan: solar power and consumption balance.
planner.job.deadline_infeasible: {device} cannot be finished by {deadline}: it is planned to start as soon as possible.
planner.job.ignored: {device} already has a job: another armed job is planned once it is done.
planner.job.start: {device} starts in this quarter hour so that it is finished by {deadline}.
planner.solver.incumbent: Best plan found within the time budget ({solve_time_s, number, ::.00} s); not proven optimal.
planner.status.expired: The plan has run out: SunCore controls without it (surplus rules only) until a new plan arrives.
planner.status.no_inputs: Nothing to plan yet: the site is not set up or Home Assistant is not connected.
planner.status.no_plan: There is no plan yet: SunCore controls on surplus rules only.
planner.status.run_failed: The last planning run failed ({error}); the previous plan stays in use.
planner.status.run_stuck: An earlier planning run is still running; no new run was started.
planner.status.run_timeout: The planning run did not finish within {limit_s, number, ::0} s; the previous plan stays in use.
planner.status.stale: The plan is older than {age_h, number, ::.0} h: SunCore controls without it (surplus rules only) until a new plan arrives.
planner.status.waiting_for_inputs: Waiting for prices and forecasts before the first plan; the plan starts at the latest {grace_s, number, ::0} s after the first connection.
planner.status.waiting_for_soc: Waiting for the battery's state of charge before planning.
planner.thermal.comfort_shortfall: {device} falls below its comfort minimum: {temp_c, number, ::.0} °C instead of at least {min_c, number, ::.0} °C.
planner.thermal.energy_only: {device} is planned without its thermal model: {cause, select, model {no learned model of sufficient quality yet} comfort {no comfort band is set} temperature {its temperature is unknown} other {no outdoor temperature forecast}}.
planner.thermal.preheat_grid: {device} pre-heats with {power_w, number, ::0} W of cheap grid power at {price, number, ::.000}/kWh (allowed in its settings).
planner.thermal.preheat_surplus: {device} stores {power_w, number, ::0} W of solar surplus as heat ({temp_c, number, ::.0} °C).
safety.battery_above_baseline: {field} = {value} W would be above your own setting of {baseline} W; SunCore only restricts.
safety.battery_byte_order_mismatch: The inverter reports the byte order {reported}, SunCore is configured for {configured}: nothing is written.
safety.battery_capability_missing: The battery adapter cannot set {field}; nothing was written.
safety.battery_external_control_off: External battery management via Modbus is off (register 1080 = {value}, needs {expected}); nothing was written.
safety.battery_fallback_unconfirmed: The inverter's fallback limits could not be confirmed; no battery limit was written.
safety.battery_frozen: The battery power has stayed at {battery_w} W while the grid power changed: battery control paused.
safety.battery_full: The battery is at {soc_pct} %, its maximum is {max_soc_pct} %: no grid charging.
safety.battery_grid_charge_bound: Grid charging with {grid_charge_w} W is above the allowed {bound_w} W (battery, inverter, plan or import limit).
safety.battery_grid_charge_policy: Grid charging is not allowed now by your price level or schedule (live price {price}).
safety.battery_grid_charge_unplanned: The current plan interval does not allow grid charging.
safety.battery_grid_unknown: Grid or battery power is unknown: no battery action that can cause import.
safety.battery_held_restored: The battery showed an older SunCore setting; SunCore writes the current one again.
safety.battery_import_limit: The house would import {projected_w} W, above the import limit of {limit_w} W.
safety.battery_import_limit_unknown: Grid charging needs a configured grid import limit.
safety.battery_inputs_stale: The measurements are too old to keep holding the battery's limits: given back.
safety.battery_min_soc_below_baseline: Minimum state of charge {min_soc_pct} % is below your own inverter setting of {baseline_pct} %.
safety.battery_min_soc_below_reserve: Minimum state of charge {min_soc_pct} % is below the reserve of {reserve_pct} %.
safety.battery_model_missing: No battery model (capacity, limits, reserve) is configured: the battery is only observed.
safety.battery_not_supported: No battery adapter is configured (the battery is only observed); nothing was written.
safety.battery_override: The battery's limits were changed outside SunCore: SunCore keeps its hands off until the next morning.
safety.battery_plan_ended: No current plan interval asks for the battery's limits any more: given back.
safety.battery_plan_stale: The plan is too old to allow this battery action.
safety.battery_range_unknown: The allowed range of {field} is unknown (entity unavailable); nothing was written.
safety.battery_release_check: Checking that the battery shows its own settings again.
safety.battery_release_confirmed: The battery shows its own settings again: SunCore has let go of it.
safety.battery_release_unconfirmed: The battery does not show its own settings again yet: SunCore retries giving it back and writes nothing else until it does. Please check the inverter.
safety.battery_reserve: Not switched on: the battery is discharging at {soc_pct} % (reserve {reserve_pct} %).
safety.battery_soc_frozen: The state of charge has stayed at {soc_pct} % although {moved_pct} % of the capacity moved: battery control paused.
safety.battery_soc_unknown: The battery's state of charge is unknown.
safety.battery_unplanned_import: Holding the battery back would make the house import, and the plan does not ask for it.
safety.battery_write_no_change: The battery already holds these limits; nothing was written.
safety.charge_not_charger: Only a wallbox takes a charging current; nothing was written.
safety.charge_not_supported: EV charging control is not available yet in this version; nothing was written.
safety.charger_needs_charge: A wallbox is controlled through its charging current only; nothing was written.
safety.climate_off: Not switched on: the unit is off and switching on is not allowed for this device.
safety.climate_switch_on_mode: Not switched on: mode {mode} is not the configured switch-on mode ({allowed}).
safety.comfort_band: Set-point {setpoint_c} °C is outside the comfort band {min_c}–{max_c} °C.
safety.comfort_band_missing: No comfort band is configured; the set-point was not written.
safety.connection_lost: Home Assistant is not connected: control is paused.
safety.crash_recovery: Restart after an unclean stop: the device was returned to its previous state.
safety.emergency_stop: Emergency stop is active: nothing is switched.
safety.ev_battery_unlocked: Charging from the grid needs the home battery held back first (it must not discharge into the car); nothing was written.
safety.ev_current_range: Charging current {current_a} A is outside the wallbox's range {min_a}–{max_a} A.
safety.ev_import_exception: Charging would draw {need_w} W, more than the allowed {allowed_w} W (surplus plus the permitted grid power).
safety.ev_mode_off: EV charging is set to off: SunCore does not start or raise charging.
safety.ev_not_connected: No vehicle is connected: charging is not started.
safety.ev_pause_unsupported: The wallbox cannot be paused (no pause switch and its current cannot go to 0 A); nothing was written.
safety.ev_phase_pause: Waiting {remaining_s} s around the phase switch before charging resumes.
safety.ev_phase_switches: Phase switch limit reached ({count} of {limit} per hour).
safety.ev_phases_charging: Phases are only switched while charging is paused.
safety.ev_phases_now: No phase switch in mode "now" (charging continues at full power).
safety.ev_phases_unknown: The wallbox's active phases are unknown: no phase switch.
safety.ev_phases_unsupported: The wallbox cannot switch phases; nothing was written.
safety.ev_release_staged: The wallbox is paused first; its previous phases and current return once the phase pause has passed and §14a dimming has ended.
safety.evcc_current_range: The charging current {current_a} A is outside evcc's range of {min_a} to {max_a} A; nothing was written.
safety.evcc_limit_range: The charge limit must be between 1 and 100 %; nothing was written.
safety.evcc_now_not_allowed: Charging now needs the EV mode now or a planned grid interval; nothing was written.
safety.evcc_plan_unverified: A vehicle plan cannot be cleared over evcc's MQTT interface (unverified); nothing was written.
safety.evcc_state_unknown: evcc's state is stale or unknown: charging is not raised.
safety.grid_cooldown: Not raised: the grid is back for too short a time (another {remaining_s} s).
safety.grid_import_caused: Not switched on: {need_w} W needed, only {surplus_w} W of safe surplus.
safety.grid_import_limit: Not switched on: the grid import limit of {limit_w} W would be exceeded (now {grid_w} W).
safety.grid_importing: Not switched on: the house is importing {grid_w} W from the grid.
safety.grid_unknown: Not switched on: the grid power is unknown.
safety.heat_limit: Not written: the tank is at {temperature_c} °C, at or above the comfort maximum of {max_c} °C.
safety.heat_pump_failsafe: Not written: the heat pump stays in normal operation because {cause, select, temperature_unknown {the store temperature is unknown or stale} heat_limit {the store is at its comfort maximum} no_probe {it has no store temperature probe} para14a {§14a dimming is active or unknown} island {the house runs in island mode} other {a safety rule applies}}.
safety.heat_temperature_unknown: Not written: the tank temperature is unknown or not current, so no more heat is added.
safety.intent_stale: Dropped: the request was too old when it reached the safety layer.
safety.inverter_above_baseline: SunCore never allows more export than the inverter's own limit.
safety.inverter_above_static: SunCore never allows more export than the configured limit of {limit_w} W.
safety.inverter_baseline_below_static: The inverter's limit is {value_w} W, below the configured export limit of {static_w} W. SunCore takes over only from your normal value; check the entity or set the limit back first.
safety.inverter_baseline_not_default: The limit register shows {value} % instead of the inverter's default {default} %. SunCore takes over only from the default, because a release writes the default back. Check the read-back sensor (address, scaling) and whether another program writes the register.
safety.inverter_baseline_unknown: The inverter's own limit could not be read: SunCore does not take the inverter over.
safety.inverter_capability_mismatch: The inverter adapter takes {capability}; this limit was not written.
safety.inverter_chain_not_exhausted: Devices or the battery can still take {headroom_w} W: the inverter is not limited further.
safety.inverter_headroom_unknown: It is unknown whether devices or the battery can still take the surplus: the inverter is not limited further.
safety.inverter_inputs_unknown: Grid or house readings are stale or missing: no inverter limit is written.
safety.inverter_island: Island operation: no inverter limit is written.
safety.inverter_limit_not_supported: No inverter adapter is configured for this limit; nothing was written.
safety.inverter_limit_out_of_range: The limit {value} is outside what the inverter accepts ({min} to {max}).
safety.inverter_limit_reset: The inverter lost SunCore's limit (for example after a restart): it is written again.
safety.inverter_may_cause_import: An AC limit of {limit_w} W could cause grid import (needed: {needed_w} W); not written.
safety.inverter_nominal_implausible: The inverter's nominal AC power of {nominal_w} W does not fit the installed {kwp} kWp. A limit in percent needs the right nominal power; check it in the inverter settings.
safety.inverter_nominal_unknown: A limit in percent needs the inverter's nominal AC power.
safety.inverter_override: The inverter limit was changed outside SunCore: SunCore leaves it alone for now.
safety.inverter_readback_lost: The inverter limit cannot be read back: SunCore gives the inverter its own limit back.
safety.inverter_release_check: Checking that the inverter shows its own limit again.
safety.inverter_release_confirmed: The inverter shows its own limit again: SunCore has let go of it.
safety.inverter_release_unconfirmed: The inverter does not show its own limit again yet: SunCore retries and writes nothing else until it does. Please check the inverter.
safety.inverter_write_no_change: The inverter already shows this limit; nothing was written.
safety.island_battery: Not applied: in backup power (island) the battery follows its own settings.
safety.island_no_increase: Not raised: the house runs on backup power (island), no load is added.
safety.late_confirmed: The device confirmed the earlier write late.
safety.lift_below_base: Not written: the set-point {setpoint_c} °C would be below your own set-point of {base_c} °C.
safety.loadpoint_needs_loadpoint: An evcc loadpoint is controlled through mode, current and limit only; nothing was written.
safety.loadpoint_not_loadpoint: Only an evcc loadpoint takes a loadpoint action; nothing was written.
safety.loadpoint_not_supported: Control of an evcc loadpoint is not available yet in this version; nothing was written.
safety.max_switches: Not switched: {count} of {limit} switch operations per hour already used.
safety.min_pause: Not switched on: minimum pause time, {remaining_s} s left.
safety.min_run: Not switched off: minimum run time, {remaining_s} s left.
safety.mode_changed: Not written: the operating mode changed before the write.
safety.mode_shadow: Mode changed to shadow: the device was returned to its previous state.
safety.mqtt_mode_raise_disabled: Home Assistant may not raise the operating mode or clear the emergency stop: this is switched off in the SunCore settings. Do it in the SunCore panel, or allow it there.
safety.no_actuator: No driver is registered for this device.
safety.not_under_control: The device is not under SunCore's control.
safety.orphan_dropped: The removed or re-mapped device could not be returned to its previous state (no longer known after a restart): please check it by hand.
safety.orphaned: The device SunCore controlled was removed or re-mapped; SunCore returns it to its previous state as soon as it can.
safety.override_detected: Manual change detected: the device is left as you set it.
safety.override_held: A manual change is respected; SunCore does not control the device for now.
safety.override_off: Switched off manually: the device stays off.
safety.override_setpoint: Set-point changed manually to {setpoint_c} °C: it is the new base value.
safety.para14a_cooldown: Not raised: the §14a reduction ended a moment ago (another {remaining_s} s).
safety.para14a_grid_charge: No grid charging: the grid operator reduces the power (§14a) or the signal is unknown.
safety.para14a_limit: Not raised: the §14a devices would draw {total_w} W, above the allowed {budget_w} W.
safety.para14a_unknown: Not raised: the §14a signal of the grid operator is unknown.
safety.power_unknown: Not switched on: how much power the device would draw is unknown.
safety.program_arm_window: Not switched off: the plug is only switched off right after arming; later it stays on.
safety.program_import_exception: The start would draw {need_w} W, more than the allowed {allowed_w} W (surplus plus the grid power the deadline permits).
safety.program_no_job: Not switched: the program is not armed (SunCore starts or prepares a program only for an armed job).
safety.program_notify_only: Nothing written: this program is started by you after a notification.
safety.program_power_unknown: Not switched: the power of the appliance is unknown or out of date.
safety.program_remote_off: Not switched off: a remote start is never switched off by SunCore.
safety.program_running: Not switched off: the program may be running. SunCore never interrupts a running program.
safety.program_switch_only: Not applied: a shiftable program is only switched on or off.
safety.proposal_expired: The proposal expired before it was confirmed.
safety.proposal_mode_changed: The mode changed after the proposal was made; confirm it again only in assisted mode. Nothing was written.
safety.proposed: Assisted mode: proposed, waiting for your confirmation.
safety.rate_limited: Not written: the device's write rate limit, {remaining_s} s left.
safety.readback_mismatch: Write not confirmed: the device did not report the new state.
safety.reconfigured: The configuration changed: the device was returned to its previous state (after its protection time, if needed).
safety.release_deferred: The device is returned to its previous state once its protection time has elapsed.
safety.release_failed: Returning the device to its previous state failed.
safety.release_pending: Not written: the device is about to be returned to its previous state.
safety.release_timeout: Returning the device to its previous state did not finish in time.
safety.released: The device was returned to its previous state.
safety.repeated_failures: Several writes failed in a row: the device is paused.
safety.sg_action_invalid: Not written: an SG-Ready heat pump is only switched between its SG states.
safety.sg_dwell: Not written: SG-Ready state {state} waits for the minimum dwell time, {remaining_s} s left.
safety.sg_forced_not_allowed: Not written: SG-Ready state 4 (forced on) is not allowed for this heat pump.
safety.sg_needs_probe: Not written: the heat pump is only intensified with a store temperature probe and a comfort band.
safety.sg_state_invalid: Not written: step {step} is no SG-Ready state SunCore may write (state 1, the utility block, is never written).
safety.shadow_mode: Shadow mode: calculated only, nothing was switched.
safety.shutdown: SunCore is stopping: the device was returned to its previous state.
safety.state_unknown: Not written: the device state is unknown, so no baseline could be recorded.
safety.superseded: Write not confirmed: the device was returned to its previous state in the meantime.
safety.surplus_unknown: Not switched on: the surplus is unknown or its inputs are not reliable.
safety.watchdog_balance: Paused: the power balance does not add up ({entity_id}).
safety.watchdog_cooldown: Paused: inputs are plausible again, waiting for the cool-down.
safety.watchdog_frozen: Paused: {entity_id} has not changed for a long time in daylight (inverter hang?).
safety.watchdog_invalid: Paused: {entity_id} has an invalid value or unit.
safety.write_no_change: Not written: the device is already in the requested state.
